items.title: Nifty slips 2% this week, FIIs offload over Rs 26,000 crore | Closing Bell
items.description: Tepid Thursday sees a sharp selloff followed by a minor recovery, with markets still set to fall for the eighth straight week. The Nifty rebounds 100 points from the day’s low but remains down over 200 points, trading below the 22,400 mark, while the Sensex recovers more than 500 points from its low. Market breadth worsens, with the VIX jumping 10%. Barring IT, all sectoral indices trade in the red, while 12 Nifty 50 stocks hit 52-week lows. The auto index remains the top sectoral laggard. Among Nifty 50 stocks, HDFC Life, Infosys and TCS are the top gainers, while Bajaj Auto, Maruti Suzuki and M&M are the top losers.

items.title: How to Build a Fresh Portfolio Now: Vikas Gupta on Smallcaps, Midcaps, Insurance and Hospital Stocks
items.description:
Vikas Gupta of Omniscience Capital says the sharp fall in September should be seen as a chance to buy quality stocks at lower prices rather than a reason to panic. Asked for his advice after such a tough month for the markets, he explains why he is treating the correction as an opportunity and how investors can approach it with a clear plan.

In this conversation, he also breaks down the recent trouble in insurance stocks, the impact of the new Supreme Court regulations on hospital stocks, and what investors should keep in mind about these sectors from here. He then walks through how to build a brand new portfolio at this point in the market, and which sectors deserve your money right now. Vikas Gupta shares his preference for smallcaps, with some selective exposure to midcaps, while staying away from largecaps. Watch the full interview to understand his strategy and positioning.
